reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI for emissions reduction and climate
themes.definition: AI applied to big data and IoT is framed as enabling emissions reduction, efficient logistics, renewables and circular economy.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI to climate mitigation or environmental efficiency.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general digitalization-for-climate claims that do not name AI.
themes.boundary_cases: If AI is only one item in a list of climate-helpful technologies without explanation, also code AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence applied to big data and the internet of things facilitate more efficient logistics and transportation, emissions reduction

themes.label: Ethical, human-centred digital technologies including AI
themes.definition: Development and use of digital technologies including AI must be ethical and human-centred, with rights protected online and offline.
themes.inclusion: Include passages requiring ethical principles or human-centredness in AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages about digital access alone.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls for UN digital cooperation in the same passage may also be coded AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: The development and use of Digital technologies, including Artificial Intelligence, based on ethical principles, must be human-centred.

themes.label: COVID-19 accelerating AI and digital deployment
themes.definition: AI is mentioned as part of a pandemic-accelerated digital revolution (with robotics, e-government, remote work), to be harnessed while mitigating negative impacts.
themes.inclusion: Include passages tying AI deployment to COVID-19 or broad digital revolution alongside other digital tools.
themes.exclusion: Exclude substantive AI-specific governance or risk discussion.
themes.boundary_cases: This is close to AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION; code both when AI is merely listed.

examples.quote: COVID-19 has accelerated the deployment of artificial intelligence, robotics, digital payments, e-government services, and remote work.

value.rationale: These 2020 passages embed AI in the wider digital transformation during COVID-19: as a climate-mitigation tool (Spain), under ethical human-centred principles (Romania), and as part of pandemic-accelerated digital deployment (Singapore).
